name: at.the-y/crm
title: The-Y CRM
description: Shared inbox for calls, WhatsApp and email: let AI set up phone, mailbox, contacts and reply drafts.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.authentication: OAuth 2.1 (sign-in by click, PKCE S256, CIMD and dynamic client registration). Alternative: header 'Authorization: Bearer <API key>' or 'X-API-Key'.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.selfHosted: Self-hosted installations serve the same endpoint at https://<your-address>/api/mcp.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.license: Proprietary (hosted service and self-hostable Docker images). Not open source.
